mapper.sql: S.SHEET_ID AS id, S.TGT_ID AS targetId, S.CALL_STATUS AS callStatus, DATE_FORMAT(S.FOUND_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS foundDate, S.CALL_RESULT AS callResult, S.TARGET_NAME AS targetName, S.INTRO_EMPL_ID AS introducerId, S.INTRO_NAME AS introducerName, S.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, S.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, S.SEX_CODE AS sexCode, S.AGE_TEXT AS ageText, S.RESIDENCE AS residence, S.PREFERRED_PLACE AS preferredPlace, S.NOTES AS notes, S.CONSULT_TOPIC AS consultTopic, DATE_FORMAT(S.MANPIK_CONFIRMED_AT, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS manpikConfirmedAt, S.MANPIK_INFO AS manpikInfo, S.ASSIGNED_USER_ID AS assignedUserId, S.ASSIGNED_USER_NAME AS assignedUserName, S.PHONE_LAST4 AS phoneLast4, S.ROW_VERSION AS rowVersion, S.DEL_IND AS deleted, DATE_FORMAT(S.SYS_RUSR_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(S.SYS_MUSR_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM CALLSHEET S
ORDER BY
S.SHEET_ID S.CALL_STATUS S.CALL_RESULT S.TARGET_NAME S.INTRO_NAME S.ORG_MSTR_CODE , S.ORG_CODE S.MANPIK_CONFIRMED_AT S.ASSIGNED_USER_NAME S.SYS_RUSR_DTTM S.SYS_MUSR_DTTM S.FOUND_DATE
, S.SHEET_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT , S.SOURCE_ENC AS sourceEnc FROM CALLSHEET S WHERE S.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND S.SHEET_ID = #{id} AND S.DEL_IND = 'N'
SELECT FROM CALLSHEET S WHERE S.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND S.SHEET_ID = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN S.ASSIGNED_USER_ID IS NULL AND S.ASSIGNED_USER_NAME = '' THEN 1 END) AS unassigned, COUNT(S.MANPIK_CONFIRMED_AT) AS manpik FROM CALLSHEET S
SELECT S.CALL_STATUS COLLATE utf8mb4_bin AS labelValue, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM CALLSHEET S GROUP BY labelValue ORDER BY cnt DESC, labelValue
SELECT S.CALL_RESULT COLLATE utf8mb4_bin AS labelValue, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM CALLSHEET S GROUP BY labelValue ORDER BY cnt DESC, labelValue
SELECT S.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, S.ORG_CODE AS districtCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM CALLSHEET S GROUP BY S.ORG_MSTR_CODE, S.ORG_CODE ORDER BY cnt DESC, regionCode, districtCode
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TGMSTR S WHERE S.LIB_ID = #{libId} AND S.TGT_ID = #{id} AND S.DEL_IND = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PSMSTR S WHERE S.EMPL_ID = #{employeeId} AND S.USE_IND = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALLSHEET ( LIB_ID, TGT_ID, CALL_STATUS, FOUND_DATE, CALL_RESULT, TARGET_NAME, INTRO_EMPL_ID, INTRO_NAME, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, SEX_CODE, AGE_TEXT, RESIDENCE, PREFERRED_PLACE, NOTES, CONSULT_TOPIC, MANPIK_CONFIRMED_AT, MANPIK_INFO, ASSIGNED_USER_ID, ASSIGNED_USER_NAME, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{libId}, #{targetId}, #{callStatus}, #{foundDate}, #{callResult}, #{targetName}, #{introducerId}, #{introducerName}, #{regionCode}, #{districtCode}, #{sexCode}, #{ageText}, #{residence}, #{preferredPlace}, #{notes}, #{consultTopic}, #{manpikConfirmedAt}, #{manpikInfo}, #{assignedUserId}, #{assignedUserName}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CALLSHEET SET PHONE_ENC = #{phoneEnc}, PHONE_LAST4 = #{phoneLast4}, PHONE_KEY_VER = #{phoneKeyVer}, SOURCE_ENC = #{sourceEnc} WHERE LIB_ID = #{libId} AND SHEET_ID = #{id} AND ROW_VERSION = 1 AND DEL_IND = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CALLSHEETROUND WHERE LIB_ID = #{libId} AND SHEET_ID = #{sheetId} AND ROUND_CODE = #{code}
